integrity: The proof reconstructs sample variance as a quadratic form in independent standardized exponential order spacings and evaluates its mixed moment with the maximum. An exact rational checker separately recomputes the relevant raw moments from factorial moments of the independent spacings and verifies the matrix identities. Finite replay checks are supplementary and are not used as proof for arbitrary sample size.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for iid exponential samples and the unbiased sample variance.
The correlation limit is a second-order asymptotic statement and does not by itself establish asymptotic independence.
An equivalent older cross-moment formula under different sampling-theory notation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exponential sample maximum and sample variance have exact harmonic covariance
